Chapter 920: Chapter 19: The Source World (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 920: Chapter 19: The Source World (Seeking Subscriptions)

The Myriad Realms Gate stands lofty and majestic at the deepest part of Lin Yuan’s mind, as if it has remained unchanged through the ages, eternal and everlasting.

Even though it is merely a projection of the true Myriad Realms Gate, it still gives Lin Yuan the illusion of surpassing the twelfth layer, even for the likes of Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master.

In front of this projection, they seem like mere dust.

This is not a comparison of physical sizes, but rather from a deeper, more fundamental level.

Lin Yuan previously guessed that the Myriad Realms Gate is an object at the level of Perfect Time Beings, based on this scene.

“Now…”

Lin Yuan’s expression is solemn as he observes the Myriad Realms Gate closely.

After his understanding of space-time entered the Seventh Realm, Lin Yuan’s perception of space-time has completely changed from before.

Now, the Myriad Realms Gate also feels different to Lin Yuan.

In fact, it’s not the Myriad Realms Gate that has changed; it has always been there and never changed.

It’s just that Lin Yuan’s realm has improved, allowing him to see more of the Myriad Realms Gate’s fundamental information, making him feel as if the gate itself has changed.

“New world coordinates have appeared?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself as dozens of world coordinates faintly emerged deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

To be precise, there are thirty-three world coordinates.

These thirty-three world coordinates, as if they had been engraved in the Myriad Realms Gate long ago, are only now perceived by Lin Yuan.

“Thirty-three worlds?”

Lin Yuan observed carefully and soon received information about these thirty-three worlds.

“These thirty-three worlds, are they all Source Worlds? Thirty-three Source Worlds?”

Lin Yuan looks pensive, the information about these thirty-three Source Worlds is scant, likely because his realm is still insufficient to perceive more information.

“Source Worlds?”

“What level of worlds are those?”

Lin Yuan is quite curious. The world coordinates that are imprinted in the deepest parts of the Myriad Realms Gate are obviously not simple, at least neither the Main Universe nor the Chaos Void has the capability to imprint their own coordinates there.

“However, this is good news for me.”

A smile appears on Lin Yuan’s face. At his current level, just one step away from the twelfth layer, his options for worlds to traverse and descend upon are very few.

In the heavens and myriad realms, among the endless dimensional planes, countless worlds exist, but the absolute majority are lower and middle-level worlds. High-level worlds like the Immortal Realm and the Main Universe are extremely rare.

If he traverses through the Myriad Realms Gate and descends into a lower-level world, Lin Yuan would feel very uncomfortable. The restrictions of a lower-level world are significant, and Lin Yuan might not even be able to grow to the level of condensing Physical Body Divine Abilities.

Moreover, since Physical Body Divine Abilities originate from bloodlines, the bloodlines of a lower-level world, even if they could condense Physical Body Divine Abilities, would probably not compare to top-tier ones such as ‘Tear Heaven’ or ‘World’.

This is also the reason why Lin Yuan has not undertaken a large number of blind random traversals.

A hundred or a thousand random traversals might not benefit Lin Yuan as much as one high-quality traversal.

Therefore.

After the eleventh traversal was completed, to embark on the next traversal, Lin Yuan had to opt for a ‘customized’ traversal.

But ‘customized’ traversals consume too much World-Breaking Origin Force, starting at a hundred strands. Along with Lin Yuan’s increasing demands in ‘customization’, the consumption of World-Breaking Origin Force would skyrocket, and eventually, ‘customizing’ a world that satisfies Lin Yuan might cost a thousand or several thousand strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

These thirty-three Source Worlds? At least in terms of level, they would not be lower than the Main Universe. Lin Yuan traversing and descending among them would certainly not face any suppression.

The operation of rules differs between different world dimensions. Staying in one world dimension for a long time, one would only sense that dimension’s operation of rules.

The operation of rules in worlds of the same level but different dimensions is markedly different. Prolonged contemplation undeniably aids in cultivation.

This is also why those close to Perfect Time Beings explore other dimensional spaces.

Not only to discover the unknown but also to experience the operation of rules in different dimensional spaces.

Maybe they’ll impact their own cultivation path and subsequently achieve a breakthrough.

“If this journey to the Immortal Realm doesn’t lead to an understanding of the Chaos Rule, I can try out these Source World coordinates,” Lin Yuan thinks to himself.

Even now, Lin Yuan isn’t certain if he can comprehend the Chaos Rule.

Comprehending the Chaos Rule at the eleventh layer is exceedingly difficult. If it weren’t confirmed that the Chaos Rule is of great help in breaking through to the ultimate level, Lin Yuan wouldn’t bother with such an unrewarding task.

With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, as long as he can step into the twelfth layer, even just into the Path Splitting Realm, the difficulty of comprehending the Chaos Rule would be greatly reduced.

…

“Thirty-three Source Worlds…”

Lin Yuan ponders, most of his attention on observing the thirty-three new Source World coordinates deep within the Myriad Realms Gate.

Out of the thirty-three coordinates, Lin Yuan can only clearly see the first three. The remaining thirty? They are incredibly vague, and he can only confirm they are world coordinates.

Lin Yuan delegates a wisp of consciousness, through the formidable power of the Myriad Realms Gate, to probe the Source World corresponding to the first world coordinate.

Humming noises.

Lin Yuan’s strand of consciousness, as if it has traveled through a long Space-Time Passage, finally arrives at a supreme space.

What comes into view is a continent that fills the heavens and the earth, a continent that is so vast. Beyond the continent, there are countless ‘meteorite’ worlds suspended in space.

In Lin Yuan’s vision, even the smallest meteorite floating on the outskirts of the continent has a vastness that rivals the Main Universe.
